versions.content: The service TcpIp_ IcmpTransmit () shall (a) construct an ICMP message according to the parameters Type, Code, DataLength and DataPtr and (b) transmit the ICMP message using the local IP address and EthIf controller specified by LocalIpAddrId to the destination specified by RemoteAddrPtr using a time to live value according to the parameter Ttl.
